name: Simple Habit
reason: Condition-led and stale: simplehabit.com's home page (still marked (c) 2017) gives its mission as helping people 'stress less', the app-store title is 'Simple Habit Sleep, Meditation', and its help centre (per search results) presents it as a mental-wellness destination with licensed therapists among its experts; the site has almost no practice content describable under the health rule. Search snippets show the app is now published by Ingenio, LLC. Owner may revisit.
